categories.main_business_segments: The Toro Company operates in two primary business segments: Professional and Residential. The Professional segment (80.3% of FY2025 sales) includes turf maintenance, irrigation, landscaping, lighting, snow and ice management, agricultural irrigation, rental, specialty, and underground construction equipment. The Residential segment (19.0% of FY2025 sales) focuses on products for homeowners, such as walk power mowers, zero-turn riding mowers, snow throwers, and yard tools. Other activities, including a domestic distribution company and certain corporate functions, are not significant.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Toro emphasizes innovation in product design, manufacturing, and engineering, with a focus on alternative power, smart-connected, and autonomous solutions. Manufacturing utilizes efficient, flexible assembly lines, vertical integration for key processes (e.g., injection molding, welding, die casting), and Lean/DFM/A methodologies to reduce costs and improve quality. The company leverages advanced technologies such as robotics, computer-automated equipment, and computer-aided design/manufacturing, and partners with vendors for component development and new technology integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include golf courses, sports fields, landscape contractors, municipalities, government entities, specialty and underground construction contractors, rental companies, agricultural producers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, home centers, and homeowners. End markets span professional turf and landscape maintenance, golf and sports turf, irrigation (commercial, residential, and agricultural), snow and ice management, and residential lawn and garden care.
categories.geographic_coverage: Toro operates globally, selling products in over 125 countries. Major manufacturing facilities are located in the U.S., Mexico, UK, Italy, Romania, Germany, Poland, and China, with sales offices in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Australia. In FY2025, 19.5% of net sales were generated outside the U.S., with significant presence in Europe, Canada, Australia, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Toro is primarily a downstream manufacturer and marketer, producing finished equipment and systems for end-users and professional contractors. The company sources raw materials and components from a global supplier base, integrates vertically for select manufacturing processes, and distributes products through a multi-channel network including distributors, dealers, retailers, and direct sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating profitable growth, driving productivity and operational excellence, and advancing sustainability. R&D is focused on alternative power (battery/electric), smart-connected and autonomous solutions, and continuous product innovation. The company pursues targeted acquisitions to enhance technology and product portfolios, and has launched the multi-year AMP initiative to drive $125M+ in annualized cost savings by FY2027.
categories.revenue_model: Toro generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (equipment, irrigation systems, parts, and accessories) to distributors, dealers, retailers, rental companies, and end-users. Additional revenue streams include service contracts, extended warranties, and licensing of trademarks for certain yard and garden tools. The company also facilitates customer financing through joint ventures and third-party arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Toro competes globally with both large and small manufacturers in turf equipment, irrigation, landscaping, construction, and residential lawn/garden markets. Key competitors vary by segment and geography, but include John Deere, Husqvarna, Honda, Briggs & Stratton, and local/regional brands. Toro is a principal competitor in most of its markets, with leading positions in golf course equipment and irrigation, and is differentiated by its broad product range, innovation, and strong distribution network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, Toro reported $4.51 billion in net sales, a 1.6% decrease from FY2024, with net earnings of $316.1 million. The Professional segment grew 1.9%, while Residential declined 14%. The company maintains strong liquidity ($1.24B available), a debt-to-capitalization ratio of 38.8%, and continues to invest in R&D, capital expenditures, and shareholder returns. Growth is driven by innovation, acquisitions, and international expansion, though recent results reflect market and supply chain challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Toro emphasizes innovative, high-quality, and dependable products supported by an extensive service network. Its value proposition centers on providing total solutions for turf, landscape, and construction professionals, as well as homeowners, with a focus on advanced technologies (alternative power, smart-connected, autonomous), sustainability, and customer support. The company leverages strong brands, broad product lines, and a global distribution network to differentiate itself in the market.
